papers.title: Further Studies into the Growth of Small Naturally Occurring Three-Dimensional Cracks in Additively Manufactured and Conventionally Built Materials
papers.abstract: MIL-STD-1530D and the United States Air Force (USAF) Structures Bulletin EZ-SB-19-01 require an ability to predict the growth of naturally occurring three-dimensional cracks with crack depths equal to what they term an equivalent initial damage size (EIDS) of 0.254 mm. This requirement holds for both additively manufactured and conventionally built parts. The authors have previously presented examples of how to perform such predictions for additively manufactured (AM) Ti-6Al-4V; wire arc additively manufactured (WAAM) 18Ni 250 Maraging steel; and Boeing Space, Intelligence and Weapon Systems laser bed powder fusion (LPBF) Scalmalloy®, which is an additively manufactured Aluminium-Scandium-Mg alloy, using the Hartman-Schijve crack growth equation. In these studies, the constants used were as determined from ASTM E647 standard tests on long cracks, and the fatigue threshold term in the Hartman-Schijve equation was set to a small value (namely, 0.1 MPa √m). This paper illustrates how this approach can also be used to predict the growth of naturally occurring three-dimensional cracks in WAAM CP-Ti (commercially pure titanium) specimens built by Solvus Global as well as in WAAM-built Inconel 718. As in the prior studies mentioned above, the constants used in this analysis were taken from prior studies into the growth of long cracks in conventionally manufactured CP-Ti and in AM Inconel 718, and the fatigue threshold term in these analyses was set to 0.1 MPa √m. These studies are complemented via a prediction of the growth of naturally occurring three-dimensional cracks in conventionally built M300 steel.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要涉及其他材料（CP-Ti、Inconel 718、M300钢）的裂纹扩展，未以Ti-6Al-4V为研究核心，对用户关注的方向帮助有限。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not focus on Ti-6Al-4V; it extends crack growth predictions to other materials (CP-Ti, Inconel 718, M300 steel) without new experimental or computational results specific to Ti-6Al-4V mechanical/fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展预测增材制造和传统制造材料中自然三维裂纹生长的方法。
summary_zh.method: 使用Hartman-Schijve裂纹扩展方程，基于长裂纹标准测试常数进行分析。
summary_zh.result: 成功预测了WAAM CP-Ti、Inconel 718和M300钢的裂纹生长。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供新的实验验证，依赖前人长裂纹数据。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to extend the capability of predicting naturally occurring three-dimensional crack growth to additively manufactured and conventionally built materials beyond previously studied Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: The Hartman-Schijve crack growth equation is employed using constants derived from ASTM E647 long-crack tests and a fixed threshold term of 0.1 MPa√m.
summary_en.result: Crack growth predictions are demonstrated for WAAM CP-Ti, WAAM Inconel 718, and conventionally built M300 steel.
summary_en.validation: No new experimental validation is provided; predictions rely on previously established long-crack data from other studies.

papers.title: Influence of Supertransus Heat Treatment on the Microstructure and Compressive Performance of Additively Manufactured Ti6Al4V (ELI)
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing (AM) has gained significant attention as a promising technique for producing complex-shaped components, particularly in the aerospace and biomedical industries. However, post-processing steps, such as heat treatment, can significantly influence the mechanical properties of additively manufactured parts. This research investigates the effect of supertransus heat treatment on the compressive behavior of Ti-6Al-4V (ELI) alloy produced through additive manufacturing. The specimens were subjected to a series of heat treatment cycles, including solution treatment and aging above the β-transus temperature range. Compressive tests were conducted on as-received and heat-treated samples to evaluate their mechanical properties and deformation behavior. Microstructure characterization was performed using optical microscopy (OM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The results revealed that the microstructure of the as-built material primarily consisted of columnar grains and acicular α' martensite. Significant variations in microstructure were observed in heat-treated samples, particularly with changes in the cooling rate. The microstructure changes closely correlated with the compressive properties of the heat-treated samples. The heat-treated samples showed a reduction in compressive strength compared to the as-received samples but exhibited improved elongation behavior. These findings contribute to the broader understanding of post-processing effects on the mechanical properties of additively manufactured materials, enabling the development of high-performance components for various applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了超转态热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V(ELI)微观结构和压缩性能的影响，与用户关注的后处理对力学性能的影响高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue or tensile testing was performed; only compressive properties were evaluated.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究超转态热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V(ELI)压缩性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 进行超转态固溶时效处理，用OM和SEM表征微观结构，并实施压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 热处理降低了压缩强度但提高了延伸率，微观结构变化与性能相关。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试和微观结构观察进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of supertransus heat treatment on the compressive behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V (ELI).
summary_en.method: Specimens were subjected to solution treatment and aging above the β-transus, with microstructure characterized by OM and SEM and compressive tests conducted.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment reduced compressive strength but improved elongation, with microstructural changes closely correlating to compressive properties.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed through compressive mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: Achieving the strength-ductility balance through the control of the prior β-grain size in laser beam powder bed fusion of Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Limited work exists on the potential for microstructural control during Laser Beam Powder Bed Fusion (LB-PBF) in α+ β Ti-alloys, particularly the impact of the process parameters on the prior-β grain size and its subsequent influence on the strength-ductility balance. Through controlling the solidification conditions, this work explores the role of the heat input parameters and laser scanning strategies in controlling the prior-β grain size and consequently the mechanical performance in LB-PBF-processed Ti-6Al-4V. Electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD) was used in combination with β-phase reconstruction to elucidate the effect of the heat input and scanning strategies on the microstructure, combined with coupled thermal microstructural modelling. The study highlights the possibility for controlling the prior-β grain size through manipulating the solidification conditions, ultimately resulting in enhanced ductility in refined structures. Moreover, whilst the majority of LB-PBF literature relies on the energy density concept to express the heat input, its significance when it comes to the microstructural characteristics was found to be minimal. Conditions with similar energy densities yielded different prior-β grain sizes, and to a lesser extent variations in the α′/α-lath size following a 650˚C/2hrs stress-relief treatment. Similarly, the use of large island scanning strategies resulted in finer prior-β grain sizes, and ultimately higher ductility following stress-relief treatment. The study highlights the possibility for controlling the microstructure in LB-PBF of Ti-alloys, both to improve the mechanical performance and design tailored microstructures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了应力消除热处理后β晶粒尺寸对Ti-6Al-4V力学性能的影响，但并未对不同后处理路线进行比较。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on controlling as-built prior-β grain size through process parameters, not on varying post-processing treatments to modify mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索通过控制激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的β晶粒尺寸来优化强度-延展性平衡。
summary_zh.method: 改变热输入参数与扫描策略，经650°C/2小时应力消除处理后，使用EBSD和热-微观组织建模表征。
summary_zh.result: 细小β晶粒在应力消除后提升延展性，能量密度不能单独预测微观组织。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观组织表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to control prior-β grain size in laser beam powder bed fusion of Ti-6Al-4V to improve the strength-ductility balance after stress relief.
summary_en.method: Heat input parameters and scanning strategies were varied, followed by a 650°C/2hrs stress-relief treatment, with microstructural characterization via EBSD and coupled thermal-microstructural modeling.
summary_en.result: Finer prior-β grain sizes led to higher ductility after stress relief, while energy density alone was insufficient to predict microstructure.
summary_en.validation: The findings are validated by mechanical testing (tensile) and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: A Study on the Mechanism of the Effect of Low‐Frequency High‐Density Pulse Current on the Strength and Ductility of TC4 Titanium Alloy
papers.abstract: The electrically assisted forming technique has attracted significant attention in recent years as an effective method for enhancing the formability of TC4 alloys. It has been demonstrated that localized overheating during the tensile deformation process induces premature melting and fracture of the specimen, thereby reducing the material's ductility. This study addresses this issue by conducting tensile experiments using high‐density (6000 A, 9000 A) low‐frequency (1 Hz) pulsed currents at various strain rates (19.8, 5, and 0.1 mm min −1 ). The results reveal that the application of electric current can reduce flow stress by 15–44% at lower temperatures. Reducing the strain rate to 0.1 mm min −1 leads to a reduction in the area of cleavage facets on the fracture surface, an increase in the size of dimples, and an improvement in the material's elongation. The application of high‐density pulsed current alters the dislocation structure, facilitating the formation of dislocation walls and dislocation cells. This process accelerates the proliferation of dislocation cells, thereby reducing dislocation entanglement. Dislocations are preferentially distributed along subgrain boundaries, resulting in a decrease in the fraction of deformed grains within the microstructure by ≈30%. First‐principles calculations are employed to validate the experimental observations and further elucidate the electroplasticity mechanism. The application of an electrothermal field is found to reduce tensile stress, in agreement with experimental data. Furthermore, the introduction of electric current lowered the vacancy formation energy of the material from 11.5 eV to 8.2 eV. Charge density difference calculations indicate that, in the presence of an electric field, atomic charges accumulate in the direction of the electric current, resulting in a reduced atomic charge density in the perpendicular direction. Conversely, when a thermal field alone is applied, despite the motion of charges in various directions, the change in charge density remains relatively small. These findings underscore the distinct effects of electroplasticity and thermal influences on the mechanical behavior of materials, providing a partial basis for understanding the microscopic mechanisms underlying the electrically assisted forming process.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是传统TC4钛合金的电辅助成形，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能，与本方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: Not about additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; paper studies electrically assisted forming of wrought TC4, with no AM content.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究低频高密度脉冲电流对TC4合金强度和塑性的影响机制。
summary_zh.method: 在不同应变率下进行高密度脉冲电流拉伸实验，结合第一性原理计算。
summary_zh.result: 脉冲电流可降低流变应力，提高延伸率，改变位错结构并降低空位形成能。
summary_zh.validation: 实验与第一性原理计算相结合进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanism by which low-frequency high-density pulse current affects the strength and ductility of TC4 titanium alloy during tensile deformation.
summary_en.method: Tensile tests were conducted under high-density pulsed current at various strain rates, combined with first-principles calculations.
summary_en.result: Pulsed current reduced flow stress by 15-44%, increased elongation, altered dislocation structures, and lowered vacancy formation energy from 11.5 eV to 8.2 eV.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results were corroborated by first-principles calculations and characterization of fracture surfaces and dislocation configurations.
